Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Five challengers in Rock the Fall will each take home $2,000.

Here's exactly how winners are chosen, because it's probably not what you'd guess.

70%

Your transformation

The change between your starting and final photos, judged against where you began. Not against anyone else.

30%

Showing up

How consistently you show up in our private community. Check-ins, posts, and supporting other women.

My coaching team and I score every entry, and the five highest scores win.

So you don't have to be the most advanced person in the challenge. You just have to show up.

Here's how it works:

1

Take your starting photos

Front, side, and back, during kickoff week. Hold onto them.

2

Train and show up in the community

Any program counts. Post, check in, and support other women along the way.

3

Submit your final photos

Send in your before and after photos at the end of week 8.

There's more to win along the way, too. Every two weeks we drop a new mini-challenge, like hydration and sleep, daily steps, or protein goals, with prizes like a Stanley cup, a $50 Lululemon gift card, or a Theragun Mini.

Both ways in are eligible for the $2,000: the $50 challenge and the $149 yearly membership.
